title: Menu
summary: Site navigation built from data -- nested sections, the current page, groups that open and close -- or from a nested list of links in the markup, drawn as the class menu: a column whose branches open in place, or a row whose branches open as panels placed by SF.Position, which becomes a button opening the same links when it does not fit. The WAI-ARIA disclosure navigation pattern, not an application menu.

template.description: Template variant name for SfBaseElement external templates.

root-class.description: Classes added to the root element the component draws.

root-style.description: Inline style declarations set on the root element the component draws, custom properties included.

orientation.description: vertical: a column whose branches open in place; horizontal: the first level in a row, each branch a panel below it (deeper ones to the side), placed by the Framework's geometry.

appearance.description: The class menu's presentations: default; documentation-tree, the tree with no borders and an indent per level; compact, a rail of first-level icons whose words stay in the link's name and whose branches do not open (both columns); navigation, a site header's sections -- rows with no frame and no fill at rest, a state-layer fill under the pointer and a plate on the current page -- a row or a column as orientation says.

current-from-location.description: Without current, the item whose link leads to location.pathname is the current page (a trailing slash and index.html do not matter); a link to a section of the page (#address) is current while location.hash names it. History navigation is followed.

collapse.description: auto: a row that does not fit its width becomes a button opening the same links as a column (with overflow collapse, the default), and a row again when the width is back; always: the button whatever the orientation; narrow: the button while the page is narrower than the md breakpoint (a phone), and then a selector -- its words and icon are the current item's; none: never.

overflow.description: What a row does when its first level does not fit (the values of sf-tabs' overflow where they mean the same): more, priority+ -- the items that do not fit leave the row from its end for a trailing «Ещё» branch (more-label), the section that holds the current page stays while it fits beside it, and with no item left «Ещё» reads «Меню» (toggle-label); collapse, the row becomes the button (collapse auto); none, the row stays whole. sf-menu-overflow says which items left.

more-label.description: The words of the «Ещё» branch of a row with overflow more; «Ещё» / «More» in the page language when not set.

open-on.description: How a row's branch opens with a mouse: hover (the default), a mouse resting on a branch opens it after 300 ms -- a region after 500 ms -- and it closes 500 ms after the mouse has left the branch and its panel (NN/g, WCAG 1.4.13); click, only a press. Touch, a pen and the keyboard always go through the branch's chevron: a section that is a page is a split control, its name a link and the chevron beside it a button «<раздел>: подразделы» (C30, APG disclosure navigation with top-level links).

indicator.description: How a row marks its first-level section that is the current page or holds it (C30, R060): line (the default), a 2 px primary line under the whole control lying on the header's bottom border, as the tabs do (sf-header-site publishes that edge), and a medium label; fill, the C23 plate, for a header with no bottom border (over a photo, transparent). An open section has the neutral select plate, never primary.

label.description: The navigation's name (aria-label of its <nav>); the element's aria-label, or the one of a <nav> written inside it, when not set.

toggle-label.description: The words of the button a collapsed menu becomes; «Меню» / «Menu» in the page language when not set.

sticky.description: The menu stays in sight while the page scrolls (position sticky at --sf-menu-sticky-top, 0 by default), and scrolls inside itself when it is taller than the view. For a section navigation beside a long page.

bordered.description: A column with a border of its own (C30 amended 2026-11-09, R072 e): a hairline of outline-variant at the surface radius, the plates space-1/4 in from it on every side, and the path to the current page marked by a 2 px primary line on its start border at the closed branch that holds it, besides the medium label. Without it a column has no frame and marks the path with the medium label alone (R065 a). A row ignores it: its panels always have the line (R084).

search.description: A search field over a column (C30 amended 2026-11-09, R071 a; off by default, never by the number of items): the rows are filtered as the field is typed in -- without case, ё as е, on the items' words and the group headings; a match keeps its parents, opened, a matching item keeps its children, closed, a matching heading keeps its group -- and the matched words are highlighted (::highlight(sf-menu-match), --sf-mark). Down from the field enters the results, Down and Up walk them, Up from the first goes back; Escape clears the field, or goes back to it from the results. A polite live region says how many matched; «Ничего не найдено» when none. The field stands still and the rows scroll when the host gives the menu a height. A row ignores it.

search-placeholder.description: The words in the search field, and its name; «Поиск» / «Search» in the page language when not set.

current.description: the id of the current page's item; with current-from-location the location decides

items.description: The items, [{id, label, href?, icon?, badge?, count?, status?, current?, disabled?, open?, region?, target?, external?, children?}] and first-level groups {group: true, label, collapsible?, open?, items}: an array in the property, the same array as JSON in the attribute. Without items the element reads the nested <ul><li><a> written inside it (data-group, data-collapsible and data-status on an <li>).

id.description: The item's name in open(id), close(id), toggle(id), current and the events; its place (item-1, item-1-2…) without it. One id names one item in the whole tree: a repeated one is left out with its children.

label.description: The row's words. Text, never markup.

href.description: The page the item leads to. An item with neither an address nor children is words in the row's place.

icon.description: An icon before the label, a name from the icon font.

badge.description: A whole number is the class counter (capped at 99+, hidden at 0, its phrase ends the link's name); other text is a short label after the words.

current.description: The item is the current page, unless the element's current names another or current-from-location finds one.

disabled.description: Unavailable: a link without an address, a branch the person cannot open or close.

open.description: A column's branch is open at first; a row's panels open only when asked.

children.description: Nested items, the same shape: an item with them is a branch. The class menu draws four levels; a deeper one is drawn as the fourth.

region.description: A row's first-level branch opens a region (a mega menu) instead of a panel: the name of a <template slot="region-<name>"> inside the element, else its children drawn as columns.

id.description: The item's name in open(id), close(id), toggle(id), current and the events; its place (item-1, item-1-2…) without it. One id names one item in the whole tree: a repeated one is left out with its children.

label.description: The row's words. Text, never markup.

href.description: The page the item leads to. An item with neither an address nor children is words in the row's place.

icon.description: An icon before the label, a name from the icon font.

badge.description: A whole number is the class counter (capped at 99+, hidden at 0, its phrase ends the link's name); other text is a short label after the words.

count.description: A count by its own name: the same as a badge holding a whole number (the class counter).

status.description: A status dot of that tone at the row's end, before the counter; its word ends the link's name.

current.description: The item is the current page, unless the element's current names another or current-from-location finds one.

disabled.description: Unavailable: a link without an address, a branch the person cannot open or close.

open.description: A column's branch is open at first; a row's panels open only when asked.

children.description: Nested items, the same shape: an item with them is a branch. The class menu draws four levels; a deeper one is drawn as the fourth.

region.description: A row's first-level branch opens a region (a mega menu) instead of a panel: the name of a <template slot="region-<name>"> inside the element, else its children drawn as columns.

target.description: The link's target (_blank for a new tab, with rel noopener). A target other than _self draws ↗ after the words; _blank says in the link's name that it opens in a new tab.

external.description: A link that leaves the site without a target of its own: ↗ after the words.

group.description: A first-level item that is a group: a heading over its items, never a destination. A row and the compact rail draw the items in the group's place, without the heading.

collapsible.description: A group whose heading is a button that opens and closes it (aria-expanded); a group is open unless open is false.

items.description: A group's items, the same as children.

open.summary: Open the branch with this id. In a row the panels not above it close. sf-menu-toggle fires for each branch that changed, source method. Answers an outcome: applied, or refused with unknown, compact, disabled, already, or fixed for a group that is not collapsible or that a row does not draw.

close.summary: Close the branch with this id; in a row the panels inside it close too. Answers an outcome: applied, or refused with unknown, compact, disabled, already, or fixed for a group that is not collapsible or that a row does not draw.

toggle.summary: Open the branch if it is closed, close it if it is open. Answers an outcome: applied, or refused with unknown, compact, disabled, already, or fixed for a group that is not collapsible or that a row does not draw.

closeAll.summary: Close a row's open panels and the panel of the button a collapsed menu is; a column's groups keep their state. Returns whether anything changed.

isOpen.summary: Whether the branch with this id is open.

sf-menu-overflow.summary: A row with overflow more changed which first-level items it shows: hidden, the ids of the items now in «Ещё», in their order (empty when all fit again).

sf-menu-search.summary: The search field's words changed: query, the words trimmed (empty when cleared), and count, how many item words and group headings match.

sf-menu:navigate.summary: A link of the menu is followed, before the browser goes. Cancellable: preventDefault() stops the navigation so a host that routes itself (a SPA) changes the page. A press with a modifier key, the middle button or a link to another window is the browser's and sends none.

item.description: The item as the element draws it.

sf-menu:toggle.summary: A branch opened or closed, by the person (source user) or a method (source method): the branch asked for first, then the ones that closed with it, innermost first. The panel of a collapsed menu sends it with id null.

accessibility.focus: A <nav> named by label, of native links and, for each branch, a native button with aria-expanded and aria-controls; a branch that is also a page has its link and its button side by side in the row. Tab walks the links and the buttons in order; Enter and Space open and close a branch; Escape closes the innermost open panel only -- a row's deepest open panel, the one the focus is in first, else the panel of the collapsed menu's button -- and gives the focus back to its button, holding the shared open-surface mark so a drawer or a modal behind stands back. Focus leaving a row closes its panels. In a row the arrows are the optional keys of the pattern: Left and Right walk the first level, Home and End go to its ends, Down and Up open a branch and enter its panel; in a panel Down and Up walk its rows, Right opens a side panel, Left closes it and gives the focus back; in a region Down and Up walk its links, Left and Right its columns. A column has no arrows. The current page's link has aria-current="page". No role=menu.

ai_guidance.use_when: Use sf-menu for site, section or cabinet navigation that comes from data or from a nested list of links: a header row, a side panel, a documentation tree.
do_not: Do not copy generated ui-smart code
Do not use it for actions on a selected object: that is sf-context-menu
Do not add role=menu: it is navigation, a list of links
Do not put markup in label: it is shown as text
Do not restyle its rows: they are the class menu's, set its public variables
Do not use sf-admin-menu for site navigation: it is the Pro admin menu
Do not make a mega menu of a column: region is a row's first level only
